discourse.title: Pilgrims! Do not tarry!
discourse.excerpt: Man is on a long pilgrimage towards God. He moves from one life to another to the goal of Splendour.
discourse.theme: Life is a long pilgrimage towards God — rest-houses along the way are for shelter, never for settling down.

reflection: Swami warns the pilgrim not to strike root in the attractive rest-houses along the way: comforts, successes and routines are shelters, not the destination. Today, name one comfort you have been treating as the goal, and take one small step past it towards what truly matters. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 7, 24 Nov 1967; nearest November discourse — no discourse dated 28 November appears in the corpus)

bhajan.title: Charana Kamala Bando Sai Nath Ke

seva_nudge: Do not tarry on one good intention you have been postponing — begin it today, even in a small way, and keep walking.
